entries.text: These are the Paradise Barrens. Pretty lonely\nplace, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_01

entries.text: According to the old legends, the ogre used to\nbe seen around here lots.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_02

entries.text: Hey, before we check out the sign...could you...\nbattle me...?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_03

entries.text: Let’s do it!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_select_01

entries.text: I dunno...
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_select_02

entries.text: ’K, let me heal up our Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_04

entries.text: I promise I’ll heal up your Pokémon and all, so\nplease, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_05

entries.text: This time...I’ll win![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_06

entries.text: It’s because I’m weak... That’s why I...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_08

entries.text: We should go check out the sign... Come on, let’s\nget this over with.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_09

entries.text: If you see a shadowy figure approaching you\noutside the village at twilight, be wary.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_01

entries.text: Don a mask at once, and hide your face.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_02

entries.text: Do so, and whether the shadow is man or monster,\nyou will pass each other by as fellow mask wearers.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_03

entries.text: If you should meet the shadow when you have no\nmask in hand, then pray that it is only a man.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_04

entries.text: If it is, you will live to see another day, and you\nwill remember to never forget your mask again.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_05

entries.text: But if it is the ogre, you will meet your end, as do\nall humans whose faces are seen by it.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_06

entries.text: Once it sees your face, your soul will be forfeit.\nAnd you shall never return to the village.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_system_07

entries.text:
In the old days, everyone carried masks wherever
they went. And...the one who made those masks
was actually my great-great-great-grandpa’s
great-great-great-grandpa...or something.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_18

entries.text: That’s amazing!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_19

entries.text: So the stories are true?!
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_20

entries.text: I mean, I don’t think any of that stuff about the\nogre stealing souls is true or anything, but...\r\nit is true that our family used to make masks.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_21

entries.text: Our family...has a long line of mask makers.\nEven my gramps can make ’em.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_22

entries.text: I even heard that the reason we hold the Festival\nof Masks is ’cause our ancestors came up with\r\nthe idea.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_23

entries.text: But I don’t really like what they wrote on this\nsign here...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_10

entries.text: Just because the ogre seemed sorta scary,\neveryone got all afraid of it and drove it away\r\nfrom the village...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_24

entries.text: But I’m pretty sure the ogre must’ve been lonely\non its own.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_11

entries.text: Left all alone like that... Treated like some kind\nof outcast...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_25

entries.text: You’re right
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_select_05

entries.text: Sorry...
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_select_06

entries.text: You think so too...huh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_12

entries.text: Wanna take that last photo?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_14

entries.text: Well, we’re all done with our assignment now.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_15

entries.text: But I’ve gotta get stronger with my Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_16

entries.text: ...I’m gonna head home.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_030_brother_17
